selection.basis: The next ten evidence-found ledger-only fields in the fresh queue, excluding the Specialized Roubaix price already reviewed and left unresolved in B85. Each selected attempt currently has accepted source IDs and no source-reuse resolution. This batch audits only those existing local sources and exact recorded claims.

targets.model: Quick Pro XR:ONE frameset with Aelous Gravel cockpit

research_route.action: One read-only Luna Max audit, sequentially checking each exact catalog record, named research attempt, and accepted source record. No browsing, writes, new source records, or new research attempts.
research_route.acceptance_rule: Add resolution.kind=source-reuse only when an accepted source directly supports the exact claim already recorded for the exact model. Preserve date, market, size, component/build, material scope, and measurement caveats; do not let reference or foreign-market prices become mainland prices, and do not upgrade qualitative stiffness wording to measured performance.
research_route.stop_rule: Audit only these ten frozen fields across six models. Leave ambiguity, source-to-model mismatch, or unsupported claims unresolved with a concise reason. Do not substitute a sibling model, infer missing values, change catalog facts, or add sources.

done_criteria: Return field-by-field source/fact matches and caveats for the ten frozen targets.
Integrate only justified source-reuse resolutions and record unresolved fields; do not change catalog facts or source records.
Run npm run validate, npm run research:check, and coverage:check; run coverage:accept only if required. Do not rerun npm run check for metadata-only changes.
Local B87 only; no push, pull request, merge, publication, or production action.
